items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: Noon and Sam and I played a trio worked out at the Lafitte Hotel for quite a while.

ctx.x: Well, Noon and Sam and I, we, we clowned around for quite a while in between band working. I mean, Noon and Sam and I played a trio worked out at the Lafitte Hotel for quite a while.
Told you you had some propit down there. You had some propit down there.
